notes.md: - **Kundurti Anjaneyulu (1922-1982):** called **"Vachana Kavitha Pitamaha"** (father of free verse in Telugu); founded the **Free Verse Front**; **Sahitya Akademi Award 1977** for ***Kundurti Kritulu***.
- **Kodavatiganti Kutumba Rao:** wrote the novel ***Chaduvu*** (1952); editor of the children's magazine ***Chandamama*** from 1952 till his death in 1980.
- **Potti Sriramulu's fast (1952):** began on **19 Oct 1952** at **Bulusu Sambamurthy's house in Mylapore, Madras** – the only Congress leader who gave him shelter; Sriramulu died on **15 Dec 1952**.
